            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is always deterministic from (last name,
            postcode), so this flag no longer creates the link. It only bypasses the
            duplicate block: a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409
            unless it sets sharesHousehold true, in which case it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the lastName. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name
                and postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with the
                same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f9a2c1b8d4e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). A derived field returned
                on the owner; duplicate detection itself is keyed on the household
                (last name and postcode). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation. Starts at 1,
                adds 1 when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode identity ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is always deterministic from (last name,
            postcode), so this flag no longer creates the link. It only bypasses the
            duplicate block: a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409
            unless it sets sharesHousehold true, in which case it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the lastName. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name
                and postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with the
                same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f9a2c1b8d4e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). A derived field returned
                on the owner; duplicate detection itself is keyed on the household
                (last name and postcode). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation. Starts at 1,
                adds 1 when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode identity ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
